title: Compact-Bench: Measuring What Context Compaction Costs Long-Horizon Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.31710v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Context compaction lets long-horizon coding agents continue beyond their context windows, but can erase the state needed to finish a task. Prior evaluations measure efficiency, retained information, or end-to-end success, leaving the effect of a specific history replacement difficult to isolate. Compact-Bench pairs full-history and summary-only continuations from a shared repository state, and evaluates recurring details and successive production compactions. It covers 35 SWE-bench repairs, 146 agentic sessions, and 106 production chains. Across 14 summarizer backbones, stable damage ranges from 5-64% of 22 full-history successes: Claude Opus 4.8 preserves the most repairs, while DeepSeek-Flash damages the most. With Kimi-K3 as summarizer, the Kimi Code prompt preserves the most task continuations (19/22), whereas Claude Code retains the most recurring details (15.0%). translated_title: Compact-Bench：衡量上下文压缩对长程编程智能体的代价
translated_abstract: 上下文压缩（context compaction）让长程编程智能体能够在超出其上下文窗口后继续运行，但可能会丢失完成任务所需的状态信息。以往的评估衡量的是效率、信息保留程度或端到端成功率，难以隔离某一次特定的历史替换所带来的影响。Compact-Bench 从相同的仓库状态出发，将“完整历史延续”与“仅摘要延续”进行配对对比，并评估重复出现的细节以及连续的多轮生产环境压缩。该基准涵盖 35 个 SWE-bench 修复任务、146 个智能体会话和 106 条生产压缩链。在 14 个摘要模型骨干上，稳定造成的损害范围达到 22 个完整历史成功案例中的 5-64%：Claude Opus 4.8 保留了最多的修复结果，而 DeepSeek-Flash 造成的损害最大。以 Kimi-K3 作为摘要模型时，Kimi Code 提示词保留了最多的任务延续（19/22），而 Claude Code 保留了最多的重复细节（15.0%）。LLM 摘要最多只能保留 16.0% 的重复细节，相比……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出 Compact-Bench 基准，通过在共享仓库状态下配对“完整历史”与“仅摘要”的延续过程，首次将上下文压缩对长程编程智能体的具体损害（如抹去 5-64% 的成功修复、最多仅保留 16% 的重复细节）从效率指标中隔离出来进行量化评估。
en_tdlr: Compact-Bench isolates the cost of context compaction for long-horizon coding agents by pairing full-history and summary-only continuations from a shared repository state, revealing that summarizers erase 5-64% of successful repairs and retain at most 16% of recurring details.
